children: Singh joins Nouveau Diamonds from Synthimed Labs, where he served as GM Finance and Finance Controller
Rajesh Singh has been appointed Chief Financial Officer of Nouveau Diamonds, effective September 2026. He is based in Mumbai, according to his LinkedIn profile.
Singh is a Chartered Accountant with more than 18 years of experience across strategic finance, treasury, working capital, governance and compliance.
He joins Nouveau Diamonds from Synthimed Labs, where he served as GM Finance (Finance Controller) from July 2025 to August 2026.

Before joining Synthimed Labs, Singh spent close to a decade at Aarti Drugs Limited in Mumbai. He served as General Manager from November 2021 to July 2025 and as Manager from September 2015 to October 2021. In these roles, his responsibilities included preparing quarterly financials in line with SEBI, BSE and Companies Act requirements.

Earlier in his career, Singh was Assistant Manager Finance at Meru Cab Company from January 2014 to January 2015. He subsequently worked as Assistant Manager at Bombay Dyeing from February 2015 to August 2015, with responsibilities covering financial and management accounting, ledger scrutiny, and consolidation of cash flow and fund flow statements.
Singh qualified as a Chartered Accountant with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India between 2006 and 2011.
